title: Rollers stats
description: A tall ruled band of three columns with very large orange figures (or three words) set as a staircase: top of the first column, middle of the second, near the bottom of the third. Each pins under the header while its column scrolls by; the figures' words rise in and captions fade up. On phones they stack.
notes: without captions the items stack tightly on phones, for a three-word section title
the sticky offset assumes the 64px rollers header
the figures read the rollers theme's --typeface-grotesk and fall back to the body face
name: rollers-stats

props.name: items
props.description: three figures (or three words), set down the page as a staircase on wide screens
